correctness.rationale: For H=[x,y]=z, derivations preserve kz, giving uniquely D(A,u) with lower-right tr(A). All Lie automorphisms are P(B,v) with central multiplier det(B). Exact conjugation sends A to BAB^{-1} and row u to [v(A-trA·I)+(detB)u]B^{-1}. The quotient row space by row(A-trA·I) has dimension 0 for det A≠0, 1 for singular nonzero A, 2 for A=0, because det(A-trA·I)=det A over every characteristic. Central scalar subgroup acts transitively on nonzero elements of 1D quotient, and determinant-twisted contragredient GL2 action transitive on nonzero rows in 2D. Thus singular similarity class splits exactly in two; nonsingular one. There are q²+q matrix similarity classes, q+1 singular, giving (q+1)² orbits. Independent exact F2 full automorphism-conjugacy enumeration over all 64 derivations gave 9 orbits, sizes [1,3,4,6,6,8,12,12,12], matching each seven-type table size; symbolic block argument, not sample, proves all fields.
residual_risks: No independent q3,q4,q5 replay of source verifier; finite F2 check is only a spot check of the all-field conjugation proof.
